features.name: Paste a link
features.what: Paste a YouTube link to save a video or song to your computer.

features.name: Audio-only downloads
features.what: Save just the sound of a video as a song file.

features.name: Playlist downloads
features.what: Paste a playlist link and save each song or video into its own folder.

features.name: Batch downloads
features.what: Add several links at once and track each one's progress.

features.name: Download queue
features.what: A queue drawer shows each download with its thumbnail and time left.

features.name: Size estimates
features.what: Shows the video and audio size before a download starts.

features.name: Already in library check
features.what: Warns you as soon as you paste a link that is already saved.

features.name: Disk space check
features.what: Flags downloads that will not fit your disk or library storage limit.

features.name: Reorder before downloading
features.what: Drag the videos of a playlist into the order you want.

features.name: Automatic retries
features.what: Failed pieces retry on their own, and stuck downloads stop and explain why.

features.name: Cancel or clear batches
features.what: Stop or clear a whole batch of downloads with one click.

features.name: Download comments
features.what: Saves the top comment threads with each video when the setting is on.

features.name: Signed-in downloads
features.what: Uses your YouTube sign-in for videos that need an account.

features.name: Download tool updates
features.what: Checks for and installs the newest YouTube download tool from Settings.

features.name: Custom playlists
features.what: Make your own playlists in your library and in Music.

features.name: Watch Later
features.what: A built-in Watch Later list for videos you want to see later.

features.name: Rename, reorder, fill
features.what: Rename a playlist, reorder it, or fill it from a library search.

features.name: Drag songs in
features.what: Drag songs onto a playlist in the sidebar to add them.

features.name: Save to playlist popup
features.what: A small popup with playlist covers and search for adding a video.

features.name: Downloaded playlist checks
features.what: Checks downloaded YouTube playlists for new videos and offers a Download button.

features.name: Delete single videos
features.what: Delete one video from a pasted playlist without losing the rest.

features.name: Playlist descriptions
features.what: Give a playlist a description of what it is for.

features.name: Import from screenshots
features.what: Build a playlist from screenshots using any chatbot, then review each match.

features.name: Playlist files
features.what: Export or import playlists as .m3u8 files.

features.name: Recommended songs
features.what: Suggests songs you don't own yet, with a 15-second preview and an Add button.

features.name: Hide suggestions
features.what: Hide a song or an artist from future suggestions for good.

features.name: Video library home
features.what: A YouTube-style home with Continue watching, your playlists, and channel rows.

features.name: Date grid
features.what: Multi-column grid of videos grouped by date, four per row on wide windows.

features.name: Tags
features.what: Tag videos by hand and open a page for each tag.

features.name: Creator pages
features.what: Open a creator's page with Home, Videos, Downloaded, and Playlists tabs.

features.name: Follow channels
features.what: Follow a channel to see its new uploads and auto-download them.

features.name: Recycle Bin
features.what: Deleted videos go to the Recycle Bin and can be restored from the title bar.

features.name: Media folders
features.what: Sorts your library into Videos, Music, Movies, Shows, and Playlists.

features.name: Library folders
features.what: Tracks all your library folders in one place and moves files between them.

features.name: Copy to a drive
features.what: Copy videos to a folder or USB drive, with a button when a drive is plugged in.

features.name: Storage overview
features.what: Groups downloads into Music, Videos, and Livestreams, with each type's size.

features.name: Storage cleanup
features.what: Frees space by removing chosen downloads in one batch.

features.name: Live library updates
features.what: Finished and deleted videos update in your library without a reload.

features.name: Chapter seek bar
features.what: Seek bar with hover previews, chapter titles, and chapter jumps.

features.name: Scrub previews
features.what: Hover previews on the seek bar, made automatically for each video download.

features.name: Sponsor skipping
features.what: Skips sponsor and other segments, with an Unskip button if you want them back.

features.name: Loop a section
features.what: Loop part of a video with the brackets button.

features.name: Most replayed graph
features.what: Shows YouTube's most replayed graph above the scrubber.

features.name: Description tab
features.what: Clickable timestamps and chapters, built from the video's description.

features.name: Comment drawer
features.what: Read the top comment threads in a drawer beside the video.

features.name: Next up panel
features.what: Shows what plays next, with watch progress and a sort menu.

features.name: End-of-video suggestions
features.what: Suggestion cards at the end, with an Up next pick.

features.name: Resume where you stopped
features.what: Videos pick up about 10 seconds before where you left off.

features.name: Zoom into a paused frame
features.what: Ctrl+wheel zooms into a paused frame up to eight times.

features.name: Mini player
features.what: A small floating player with compact and large layouts.

features.name: Audio file player
features.what: Full player for songs with an equalizer and waveform bars.

features.name: Captions
features.what: Shows captions, with auto captions in complete phrases.

features.name: Music mode
features.what: A Spotify-style player with Home, Explore, Library, and a vinyl view.

features.name: YouTube Music Explore
features.what: Browse YouTube Music and download songs or picked tracks as audio.

features.name: Artist and album pages
features.what: Artist, album, and song pages with Play, Shuffle, and credits.

features.name: Song info
features.what: Fills in correct titles, cover art, and genres for your songs.

features.name: Synced lyrics
features.what: Lyrics that follow the song when they are available.

features.name: Now Playing panel
features.what: Side panel with lyrics, related songs, credits, and what plays next.

features.name: Crossfade
features.what: Blends one song into the next, from 0 to 12 seconds, off by default.

features.name: Loop and autoplay
features.what: Loop off, all, or one, with autoplay that plans ahead.

features.name: Listening stats
features.what: Play counts, top 10 lists, and a smart shuffle based on your plays.

features.name: Liked Songs
features.what: Heart songs to build a Liked Songs list that shapes your picks.

features.name: Music profile
features.what: A profile page with your YouTube account, stats, and storage.

features.name: Search
features.what: One search bar finds songs, playlists, albums, and artists in your library.

features.name: About the artist
features.what: A sheet with a Wikipedia bio, photos, your plays, and top tracks.

features.name: Delete a song
features.what: Moves a song to the Recycle Bin, restorable like videos.

features.name: Browse YouTube
features.what: Browse YouTube inside RuForge without opening a browser.

features.name: Back, forward, and reload
features.what: Title bar buttons to go back, forward, or reload the page.

features.name: Bottom address bar
features.what: Bottom bar shows the current page URL, with paste and copy buttons.

features.name: Follow from Explorer
features.what: Follow a channel straight from the page you are viewing.

features.name: YouTube profile
features.what: Your avatar and handle show in the title bar, or a Log in button.

features.name: Full-window Explorer
features.what: Explorer fills the window under the title bar.

features.name: Notification bell
features.what: The title bar bell collects new uploads and download results in one list.

features.name: One-click actions
features.what: Notices come with one-click actions, such as Download.

features.name: Background island
features.what: Shows downloads and what's playing in a small island when RuForge is in the background.

features.name: Island filters
features.what: Filter the island to uploads or downloads, and mute each kind.

features.name: Bottom-center popups
features.what: Popups appear at the bottom center, sized to fit their text.

features.name: Channel upload alerts
features.what: Tells you when followed channels post new uploads or premieres.

features.name: Download result notices
features.what: Shows a check or a warning when each download finishes.

features.name: Playlist check notices
features.what: A bell notice when a downloaded playlist has new videos.

features.name: Storage full badge
features.what: A storage badge on the download row when storage is full.

features.name: Accent color
features.what: Pick any dark accent color next to the swatches.

features.name: Black video theme
features.what: Black video mode with your accent, and Legacy colors for the old brown.

features.name: App density
features.what: Cozy or Compact sizing that slims the title bar and side rail.

features.name: Hide chrome during video
features.what: Title bar and side rail can hide while a video plays.

features.name: Slim scrollbars
features.what: Scrollbars in a slim RuForge style instead of the Windows default.

features.name: Settings window
features.what: Settings open in a centered window with tabs and a search box.

features.name: Playback settings
features.what: A Playback tab for auto-advance, preloading, and SponsorBlock.

features.name: Onboarding tips
features.what: Short tips in the library and Music, each one dismissed for good.

features.name: Export button toggle
features.what: The title bar export button is off by default and can be turned on.

features.name: Shortcuts tab
features.what: Ctrl+/ opens a tab that lists every shortcut, and each can be rebound.

features.name: Player keys
features.what: C for captions, M for mute, K to play or pause, and arrows to seek.

features.name: Paste-link shortcut
features.what: Ctrl+D opens the paste-link downloader.

features.name: Alt quick menu
features.what: Hold Alt for a quick menu that switches between modes, including Music.

features.name: New playlist shortcut
features.what: Ctrl+N starts a new playlist.

features.name: Media keys
features.what: Keyboard media keys play, pause, and skip tracks.

features.name: Automatic update checks
features.what: Checks for new versions once per launch and installs them for you.

features.name: Update island
features.what: New updates appear in the island, with an install button.

features.name: Update fallback
features.what: Checks ruforge.app first and falls back to GitHub if the site is down.

features.name: What's New tiles
features.what: After an update, each new feature gets a tile that opens it.

features.name: Crash recovery screen
features.what: A friendly screen offers Reload and the error details if something breaks.

features.name: No usage tracking
features.what: RuForge sends no usage stats or crash reports.

features.name: Private activity log
features.what: Keeps a private activity log on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.

features.name: Discord activity
features.what: Optionally shares what you watch or download on Discord, off by default.

features.name: Website install
features.what: ruforge.app shows the latest version and installs straight from the site.

features.name: License notices
features.what: The installer includes license notices for its bundled tools.
